MANILA GOV'T, UST OFFICIALS DISCUSS PROPOSAL FOR RAINWATER CATCHBASIN FACILITY TO SOLVE FLOODING 

LOOK: UST officials meet with Manila Mayor Francisco “Isko Moreno” Domagoso to discuss the city government’s proposal to build a rainwater impounding facility beneath the campus. 

The proposal to build a similar facility underneath UST had been raised several times before, but the administration rejected it because the campus is home to several National Cultural Treasures, including the Open Field, Main Building, Central Seminary, and Arch of the Centuries.  

During the consultation, Domagoso met with UST Facilities Management Office Director Fr. Dexter Austria, O.P., and Asst. Director Albert Surla, who will bring the proposal to the UST Board of Trustees.  

Story to follow.  

(Photos from the Manila Public Information Office)

San Miguel Corporation (SMC) has signed a memorandum of agreement with the Quezon City government to clean and rehabilitate major rivers in the city, expanding the company’s Better Rivers PH initiative aimed at reducing flooding in Metro Manila.

Under the agreement, SMC will deepen and widen key sections of the San Juan River and extend its cleanup of the Tullahan River up to La Mesa Dam, building on its 2020–2022 pilot effort that cleared 1.1 million metric tons of silt and solid waste from 10.9 kilometers of the waterway.
